parsed.title: Unlock Commenting with Game Play
parsed.oneLiner: Allow non-signed-in users to post a single comment after playing a game.

newMechanic.name: One-Time Comment Post
newMechanic.description: Allows a guest user to bypass the mandatory sign-up wall to post exactly one comment by watching a rewarded ad. The app preserves the user's typed comment in local state during the ad flow and restores it upon REWARD_VERIFIED.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: Comment sections thrive on volume; many users want to participate but churn at the sign-up gate.

parsed.trigger: User initiates a comment on s05 and triggers the sign-up wall. The app saves the current draft to local storage and restores it on REWARD_VERIFIED [ANTI-5].
parsed.eligibility: Non-signed-in users on the Add Comment Page (s05) who encounter the sign-up wall.

offer.title: Post This Comment
offer.body: Play a 15-second game with AOL News to post your comment without signing up.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: The offer is gated specifically to users who hit the sign-up wall. The primary 'Sign Up to Post' CTA remains the default. The reward is limited to a single post, ensuring users who want a long-term voice still have a clear incentive to sign up. Draft persistence ensures the comment text is preserved [ANTI-5].
risks: Users may find the ad wall frustrating compared to a seamless sign-up.
One-off comments may be lower quality than member comments.
